provenance.costMetric: CPU seconds (ru_utime+ru_stime of the waited-for child tree). Wall time is recorded per compile but is NOT comparable between the before and after columns and no claim rests on it: the 21 standalone compiles ran 5-way parallel and the 2 bundle compiles 2-way, on a host carrying unrelated load at average 75-140 on 32 cores. CPU seconds are stable under contention and are what CI is billed for.
provenance.runMetric: one process per case, `--run "suite::test"`; two passes, the second reported
provenance.note: Every binary here was compiled fresh. No figure is read back out of a pre-existing artifact, and none is carried forward from the earlier campaign report.

limits.rationale: See `MaxBundleMembers` in scripts/generate_test_edges.nim. 24 is the largest membership executed clean end to end (the repro_solver bundle); it bounds what may be attempted, and every bundle still has to show per-case pass plus whole-binary exit 0 on its own evidence.

mutations.note: Mutation runs that show the three verification cases in tests/integration/t_m4_pure_unit_consolidation.nim CAN fail, and fail SEPARATELY. Run at review against freshly compiled binaries (the 21 member sources and both bundles rebuilt from scratch with the compileCommand above). Recorded here because scripts/generate_test_edges.nim cites this file for them; before this block that citation pointed at nothing.
mutations.harness: Backup/restore is an explicit byte snapshot of exactly the files each mutation touches, NOT `git checkout --`: this batch adds untracked files and `git checkout -- .` refuses wholesale when any path is untracked, which once left the tree dirty and made a suite-rename read as a larger break than it was. `git status --porcelain` was compared to the pre-mutation listing after every run and matched exactly, and the bundle binary's md5 was confirmed unchanged after the two mutations that rebuild it.

Cases 2 and 3 stay green because they only look at bundles the ledger DOES list, which is exactly why case 1 has to carry this one.

runs.what: make `repo_local_import_edges` in scripts/reprobuild_suite_inventory.py return the empty list, so the purity predicate's closure resolves nothing and collapses back to reading each test's own import clause
runs.reads: exactly the 31 refused entries flip back to `pure unit` and the gate names each one with its lost reason, plus `aggregate sections that no longer match: static, observedStructuralFacts, pureUnitConsolidationCandidates`. Recorded because the new closure machinery has no direct unit test of its own: this is the check that covers it, and this run is the evidence that the check DISCRIMINATES rather than agreeing with whatever the scan happens to produce.

mutations.limitEnforcementPoints: maxBundleMembers and maxBundleOwners are enforced in the generator (checkBundleLimits, which quits rather than warns, verified live by M4-gen-owners and M5-gen-size) AND asserted from this ledger by test_consolidation_reduces_binary_footprint. maxDependencyRoots is asserted from this ledger ONLY; the generator has no corresponding constant.
mutations.negativeControls: `--run` was confirmed to DISCRIMINATE rather than exit 0 for anything: `--run "no such suite::no such test"` exits 1, and a bare test name with the suite stripped off exits 1, both against a real bundle. Without this every per-case exit-0 assertion in the verification test would be vacuous.

bundlesNotCoveredByThisLedger.bundle_repro_solver_pure_unit: Landed by the earlier batch recorded in reprobuild-suite-m4-consolidation.md. Its 24 members no longer have standalone binaries, so the per-member "before" case lists this ledger is built from cannot be measured for it without reverting the batch. Named here rather than silently uncovered: the verification test requires every bundle the generator declares to be either in `bundles` or in this table, so a NEW bundle cannot arrive unchecked.

suite.binariesAddedByThisBatchNote: tests/integration/t_m4_pure_unit_consolidation.nim, the verification test this batch brings with it. Stated separately so the consolidation delta is not quietly netted against it: 21 members leave, 2 bundles and 1 verification binary arrive, so the suite falls by 18 while consolidation removes 19.
suite.staticCaseSumNote: the +3 is this batch's own verification test (tests/integration/t_m4_pure_unit_consolidation.nim); consolidation itself contributes 0
suite.consolidationGroupsNote: -2 consumed by this batch; the other -6 are the closure repair to the pure-unit predicate, which refuses 31 entries that reach a disqualifier through a repository-local path import
